mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 4% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4%, and PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 jobs per month, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns falls below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $400 billion MoM indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS growth > $350B.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase by more than 0.5% in a month, the combined signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase > 0.5% in a month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE below 3.5% with PAYEMS growth above 100,000 jobs per month indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1.6 million units per month signals robust housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 45% of months with HOUST > 1.5M units.
